sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored
sources.snippet: Ollama build of Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored — an abliterated (refusal-removed) build of Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B, a 27B dense hybrid-attention (Gated DeltaNet linear + full attention) native vision-language model with reasoning, tool-calling, and an MTP speculative-decoding head. Sixteen tags from 2-bit to 8-bit, each with the mmproj vision projector bundled in — nothing extra to fetch. Browse all ...
